_comment: The products OIO actually sells. A design is artwork; a product is that artwork on one blank we chose. `primary` is the one card that represents a design inside its category — the rest surface through 'Also on' on the product page. Every productTypeId in `default` is verified available on every published design; `byDesign.swap` replaces a slot for designs whose art needs a different blank (ink color is fixed per sellable, so a light print means a different blank, not a different color choice).

5d89f20f13615160bf833e7d._why: Art is a black print on the Bella + Canvas blank, which has no light-ink version. Gildan Heavyweight Unisex carries an E5E5E5 print, so the design can run white on black.

5d89f19b162c5f464e875bc1._why: Bella + Canvas has no yellow garment. Men's Premium T-Shirt stocks sun yellow and carries the black print. Relabelled because that blank is a men's cut, not a unisex one.
